title: Navimower 0.5.0-beta31

## Pause, Resume and selected-zone continuation fix

- Map Card Smart Resume now prioritizes the vendor's real `c:behavior type=3` Resume on a confirmed paused task (including vendor paused state 0211), rather than sending another `s:mower reset=false` for a retained ordered run.
- A Mow action with Reset OFF and the *same* retained zone selection while paused uses vendor Resume without resetting progress. Different or uncertain zone selections are rejected with an actionable error instead of sending a misleading accepted-but-inert zone command; choose Reset ON only when deliberately creating a new task.
- Optimistic HA mowing activity no longer hides an authoritative paused vendor state when live MQTT does not report mowing.
- A vendor command acknowledgement is not physical execution: commit retained ordered-run metadata and requested new-cycle resets only when post-send vendor telemetry confirms mowing. Unconfirmed attempts retain existing tracked work.
- Preserve the legacy dedicated `navimower.resume` action, ordered-zone continuation when not paused, schedule ownership, and gate interlock behavior. No automatic retries or extra polling.
- Add regression coverage for paused optimistic activity, same/different-zone Reset OFF routing, and deferred new-cycle commits.

Field validation is still needed; beta30 diagnostics showed `Answered` on both non-working paused `s:mower` commands, so this version corrects our routing and bookkeeping rather than claiming vendor firmware behavior changed.
